summary: HUTCHMED (China) Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an exclusive license agreement with GSK for HMPL-A830, a KRAS-EGFR antibody-targeted therapy conjugate (ATTC) cancer candidate. HUTCHMED receives a US$110 million upfront payment plus up to US$1.185 billion in milestones and royalties. GSK obtains worldwide rights excluding Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. HUTCHMED will conduct global Phase I development. A licensing transaction, not a typical special-situation corporate event.
